about.name: João Santos
about.paragraph1: I am a full-stack developer currently completing my degree in Systems Analysis and Development, with experience across the full software lifecycle. My work goes from requirements gathering and problem understanding to system modeling, business logic, interface design, development, testing, deployment, and user enablement.
about.paragraph2: My focus is on building complete, scalable, and secure applications while keeping technical quality aligned with a modern and intuitive experience.

kodaAi.title: Koda AI
kodaAi.role: An AI platform for everyday business tasks
kodaAi.description: Koda AI brings chat, custom agents and creative tools into a business platform. With Gemini APIs and Adobe integration, it supports content generation, image creation and document review. Files and suggestions stay side by side, with authentication and individual access control.
highlights: AI chat and custom agents for different work needs.
Document review with the PDF and suggestions in one interface.
Gemini APIs and Adobe integration to connect creative tools.
Auth0 authentication and individual access control for business use.
kodaAi.summary: AI chat, custom agents and integrations for creating and reviewing work in context.

centrix.title: Centrix
centrix.role: An independent brand, digital presence and sales automation
centrix.description: I founded Centrix to make technology more accessible to small businesses and entrepreneurs. I built its digital presence to introduce tailored solutions, explain the delivery process and make it easier to get in touch. The project also includes an initial email outreach setup and a configured WhatsApp Business channel.
highlights: A company website presenting services, partners and contact channels.
A visual walkthrough of discovery, development, validation and support.
Automated email outreach setup and WhatsApp Business configuration.
An independent business focused on the needs of small companies and entrepreneurs.
centrix.summary: Tailored digital solutions, from the first conversation to a small business’s online presence.

sprintly.title: Sprintly
sprintly.description: Sprintly brings tasks, projects and deadlines into a shared workspace for teams. It connects the sprint board to a delivery timeline, helping people track priorities, ownership and time spent on activities. An integrated view for organizing work and following the progress of each project.
highlights: A sprint board with activities grouped by status and priority.
A visual delivery timeline with dates, owners and overdue indicators.
Estimates, logged time, comments and checklists for individual tasks.
Project, team and activity views for exploring work at different levels.
sprintly.summary: Connected sprints, activities and timelines that bring clarity to teamwork.
sprintly.statement: From the plan to the delivery.

prisma.title: Prisma
prisma.description: Prisma connects customer relationships to daily sales work. Deals, contacts, proposals and actions come together in a CRM with a visual pipeline, integrated AI and Microsoft services. Automation features, including n8n and a workflow editor, help structure actions, decisions and notifications throughout the process.
highlights: A visual sales pipeline with stages, priorities and status indicators.
Customer details with organized contacts, proposals and follow-up actions.
Email composition within the context of customer relationships.
A visual workflow editor with actions, conditions and notifications.
prisma.summary: Customers, deals and automation in a CRM that follows every stage of the sales relationship.
